_help: What the MCP server (app-tests/mcp, started with MCP_APP=egenome) needs to know about this app: its name and package, the .env key of the device id, the device suites the assistant may start (npm run test:<suite>) and what a run does to the device. The assistant shows 'effects' to the user before a run starts.
name: eGenome.ai

smoke.what: the 8 most important tests: login, Home, Reports, Premium, Settings, sign out

regression.what: every P0 / P1 flow (6 spec files)

layout.what: visits 15 screens and checks their layout

effects: The eGenome app's data on this device is CLEARED first: the test account is logged out and any app data there is lost.
The tests log in with the test account from .env and go through the app.
